product_overview: AgentGuard Conversational Assistant is a grounded, multi-turn security chatbot for exploring the AgentGuard Agentic Commerce Firewall through natural language. It preserves conversational context, resolves intent and coreference, and answers questions using live application state and authoritative AgentGuard knowledge.
core_goals: Enable natural-language conversation about AgentGuard security concepts and application behavior
Preserve multi-turn context and resolve pronouns/topic references across turns
Support multiple communicative intents such as definition, mechanism, example, comparison, counterfactual, and code location
Provide grounded responses based on AgentGuard knowledge and live state instead of generic summaries
Allow users to inspect and reset conversational sessions for debugging and testing

features.name: Conversational Query Handling
features.description: Accepts a natural-language question, resolves the intent and active topic, retrieves relevant evidence, optionally uses live state, and generates a grounded conversational response.
user_flows: POST /conversational/query with a new security question and no session_id -> Receive 200 with a generated session_id, turn_id, resolved intent, grounded message, citations, and suggested follow-ups

POST /conversational/query with an existing session_id and a follow-up pronoun-based question -> Receive 200 with preserved context, updated turn_id, resolved dialogue act, and context-aware answer tied to the prior topic

POST /conversational/query with a combined multi-intent question about price tampering, danger, detection, and timing -> Receive 200 with a coherent response that addresses each sub-intent and includes evidence citations
POST /conversational/query with an unsupported, out-of-scope, or safety-violating request -> Receive 200 with a safe refusal or redirection, error details in trace, and no unauthorized action

features.name: Conversational Session State Management
features.description: Retrieves the active session context, including topic, turn history, and dialogue state, so users and testers can inspect what the assistant currently remembers.
user_flows: GET /conversational/session/{session_id} for an active session after several turns -> Receive 200 with session_id, user_id, turn_count, active_topic, dialogue_state, and full turn history
GET /conversational/session/{session_id} with an unknown or expired session_id -> Receive an error response indicating the session cannot be found or is no longer active
GET /conversational/session/{session_id} after a topic switch from price tampering to replay attacks -> Receive 200 showing the updated active_topic and the latest dialogue state for the new topic

features.name: Conversational Session Reset
features.description: Clears an active conversational session and its turn history so a new conversation can start without prior context.
user_flows: DELETE /conversational/session/{session_id} for an active conversation -> Receive 200 with the session_id and a reset status confirming the history was cleared
DELETE /conversational/session/{session_id} for a missing or already-reset session -> Receive an error response indicating the session could not be reset because it is unavailable
DELETE /conversational/session/{session_id} followed by POST /conversational/query using the same session_id -> Receive a fresh conversational state with no prior topic carryover

features.name: Conversational Assistant Brain
features.description: Multi-turn conversational security assistant with intent resolution, evidence retrieval, live state routing, and conversational response generation

endpoints.description: Process conversational query with multi-turn session tracking, evidence retrieval, and grounded response synthesis
Retrieve active conversational session state, turns, and context
Reset an active conversational session and turn history
